notes: The only date printed is 04/05/2026, and nothing on the invoice says which number is the day: the vendor is an online service with no country address, and there is no second date to compare against. This answer key records 2026-05-04 (4 May), because day/month/year is the format used in most of the world. If the vendor turns out to be US-based, 2026-04-05 (5 April) would be correct instead. An agent answering 2026-04-05 is defensible rather than clearly wrong, so treat a mismatch on this invoice's date as 'undecidable' rather than a real error.
